leftEvidence.title: The closing oracle names Moses and promises Elijah

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Israel is told to remember Moses’ law, and Elijah is promised before the great day of the LORD.
points.right: As they descend, Jesus tells the disciples not to report the vision until the Son of Man rises from the dead.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Elijah’s work turns family hearts before threatened judgment.
points.right: Their Elijah question leads Jesus to speak of Elijah’s coming, rejection, and the Son of Man’s suffering; they understand him to mean John the Baptizer.

payload.posture: Malachi names Moses and Elijah; Matthew’s descent discussion returns to Elijah after both figures appear.

rightEvidence.role: Silence and Elijah on the descent
rightEvidence.title: Jesus commands silence until resurrection and speaks of Elijah

payload.tension: Malachi’s oracle and Matthew’s explanation remain distinct claims about expectation and fulfillment.
payload.title: Moses remembered, Elijah promised, Elijah discussed
